CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when this gift is exactly in the Mid band — either its own CurrentAmount lands in the Mid one-time band, or (installment inheritance) its parent GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount lands in the Mid lifetime band, and neither dimension puts it into Major. The three gift checkboxes (Entry / Mid / Major) are mutually exclusive — at most one is TRUE for any gift. Installment inheritance: a payment against a large commitment inherits the commitment's tier. Thresholds are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Tier or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold values recalculates this field across all Gift Transaction records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required.
CustomField.formula: AND( OR( AND( CurrentAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.One_Time_Min_Amount__c, CurrentAmount < $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.One_Time_Min_Amount__c ), AND( GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount < $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c ) ), NOT(CurrentAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.One_Time_Min_Amount__c), NOT(GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. The field is checked when this gift's amount qualifies for the Mid donor tier, or when it is an installment payment against a Mid-tier commitment. Your administrator controls the threshold amounts.
CustomField.label: Is Mid Gift
